query: 结社自由与集体谈判 结社自由与集体谈判 衡量企业保障员工自愿组建、加入工会等组织，并以此与雇主进行有关薪酬、福利、工作条件等事项集体协商权利的程度。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：发布了明确的结社自由声明，包含“禁止打压/歧视工会代表”的专项条款；具备完善的集体谈判争议处理流程；披露了具体的集体合同关键条款及审议机制。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的政策承诺，具备工会或职工代表大会（职代会）组织，但缺乏深度的禁止打压机制说明或具体的集体协商争议解决程序。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“重视沟通”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：相关政策及集体合同覆盖 >80% 的员工或经营地区。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅在国内主体执行而未覆盖海外子公司，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 结社自由 集体谈判 工会 集体合同 职工代表大会 劳资协商 禁止打压工会代表 集体协商 freedom of association collective bargaining trade union collective agreement works council labour-management negotiation non-retaliation against union representatives 是否发布结社自由或集体谈判政策声明？ 是否包含禁止打压/歧视工会代表的条款？ 是否存在工会、职代会或集体合同机制？ 集体谈判争议如何处理？ 政策或集体合同覆盖多少员工或地区？

When the human resources department conducts recruitment work, it shall strictly verify the personal identity of the applicant and perform background checks well to avoid child labour. Employees at production bases are recruited of their own accord. The staff induction process is carried out in line with corporate systems and procedures where no child labour is employed. If any illegal employment of child labour or forced labour is discovered, the Group will immediately terminate the employment contract, identify the cause and pursue responsibility, and impose appropriate penalties on the employee and related person in violation.

results.text: The Group procures raw materials from the market for producing magnesium metal and magnesium alloys. The Group has developed corresponding inspection, assessment and selection procedures for raw materials suppliers. Upon receipt of bids from raw materials suppliers, the Group assesses comprehensively from the aspects of brand, quality, payment, schedule of delivery, reputation, and after-sales service, and seriously considering their energy and environmental policy to maximise environmental protection and minimise pollution. The most appropriate product supplier is determined based on a comprehensive score and ranking assessment by comparing individual suppliers. It ensures that premium-quality raw materials can be sourced at competitive prices, and the values of the selected supplier on environment, community and ethics are embraceable. All of the Group's suppliers are located in mainland China. There are about 10 major suppliers. During the Reporting Period, there were no material instances of non-compliance concerning the supply chain management.
